Close to the Greek.
NASB follows the critical text (“in Christ”); “heavenly realms” is rendered “heavenly places.”
NASB ends the verse with a period and places “In love” at the start of v. 5's sentence.
NASB joins “In love” from v. 4 to this verse; “good pleasure” is rendered “kind intention.”
NASB follows the critical text (“which”); “freely given” is rendered “freely bestowed.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “our.”
NASB ends the sentence at “us” and joins “In all wisdom and insight” to v. 9.
NASB begins with “In all wisdom and insight” from v. 8; “pleasure” is rendered “kind intention.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “with a view to,” “suitable,” and “that is,” and renders “to bring together” as “the summing up.”
NASB renders “according to the counsel” as “after the counsel.”
NASB follows the critical text; “having first trusted” is rendered “who were the first to hope,” and it reorders the verse.
NASB renders “having heard the word” as “after listening to the message,” adds “in Him,” and sets off a clause with a dash.
NASB follows the critical text (“who”); it adds “given,” and renders “guarantee” as “pledge” and “the acquired possession” as “God's own possession.”
NASB adds “which exists” and “your.”
NASB follows the critical text without “of you”; it adds “while.”
NASB renders “spirit” in lowercase and adds “of.”
NASB follows the critical text (“heart”) without “and”; it adds “I pray that.”
NASB adds “These are” and renders “the might of His strength” as “the strength of His might.”
NASB follows the critical text (“seated”); “worked” is rendered “brought about.”
NASB adds “far” and renders “principality” as “rule.”
NASB renders “put under” as “put … in subjection under.”
NASB follows the critical text.
